tools.name: search_files
tools.description: Search for files by name on the local disk of this computer. Matches file names only, not their contents.

tools.name: find_files
tools.description: Find text inside files on the local disk. Returns each file and line where the phrase appears; does not match file names.

tools.name: locate_files
tools.description: Locate files by name in the user's cloud drive (synced online storage). Does not look at the local disk.

tools.name: query_files
tools.description: List files on the local disk that were modified within the last N days, newest first.
